newsitem.title: USA: Wright Medical buys USG Corp unit.
newsitem.headline: Wright Medical buys USG Corp unit.

text.p: Wright Medical Technology Inc said on Monday it has acquired the biomaterials business from United States Gypsum Company, a unit of USG Corp.
The business includes patents, technologies and proprietary processes related to the use of calcium sulfate (gypsum) in the human body, Wright said.
Prior to the acquisition, Wright said it has worked closely with U.S. Gypsum as the exclusive licensee and orthopaedic distributor of U.S. Gypsum's bioresorbable calcium sulfate materials.
Under the terms of the acquisition, Wright will continue to purchase the medical grade calcium sulfate raw material from U.S. Gypsum.
